settings.headline: From Akron to your doorstep.
settings.body_before:
In 2023, Redkisses started making custom bracelets and lip gloss for friends right here in Akron, Ohio. She'd hand-mix pigments, string beads at the kitchen table, and post what was in stock on Instagram.

Within six months, the friends became strangers. Strangers became DMs asking for gloss restocks. DMs became orders. Orders became a brand. Redkisses officially launched as an LLC in late 2024 — still run out of Akron, still packed by hand, still obsessed with not over-charging.
settings.pullquote: Shine on a budget isn't a slogan. It's the whole reason the business exists.
settings.body_after:
Today we stock over 40 products across lip gloss, jewelry, shades and sets. Every piece is personally tested before it gets listed — if it doesn't pass the shine test, it doesn't make the cut. Every order is hand-packed. Every DM gets a real reply. That's the whole model.

We're not trying to be a mall counter. We're not trying to be Amazon. We're trying to be the shop your friend would recommend to you. That's enough.

settings.headline: Hey — it's Redkisses.
settings.body:
I started making custom bracelets and glosses for friends right here in Akron, Ohio. Friends became customers, customers became a brand. The name comes from the very first thing I ever made and sold — a red lip gloss with a little too much shine.

Every gift set you order, I pack. Every DM on Instagram, I answer. Every new gloss and piece goes on me first before it goes on the shop. If something doesn't work, I'll be the first to tell you.

Thanks for shopping small. It means everything.

settings.title: Honest pricing
settings.copy: We mark up less. Always. If we can't beat a competitor on price, we don't sell it.

settings.title: Tested first
settings.copy: Every gloss and piece is tried before it's listed. If it doesn't shine, it's out.
